phase: V6 Phase 7 - Gemini HTTP timeout reliability fix
objective: Enforce a genuine total wall-clock deadline over DNS, TCP connect, TLS, response headers and response body without changing the provider architecture or request contract.

confirmed_defects.detail: socket.getaddrinfo had no timeout in URL validation.
connect_timeout_seconds was advertised in readiness but never passed to the transport.
The 60 s value bounded individual socket operations, not total request time.
response.read() could exceed the intended overall deadline while a server trickled data.

mechanism: DNS resolution runs in a daemon worker and the caller stops waiting at the deadline.
TCP connect uses a bounded socket timeout and tries resolved addresses in order.
TLS uses CERT_REQUIRED and check_hostname with a bounded timeout.
A daemon watchdog closes the registered socket when the total deadline expires.
Header and body reads use min(remaining deadline, stage budget).
A truncated body is returned as text with json_parse_skipped=true.

stage_budgets.total_seconds: caller timeout (60 for the Phase 7 request)

limitations: The bounded transport was not exercised against a live provider in this phase.
The watchdog closes the socket; a third-party resolver thread may remain until it returns.
Stage budgets are defaults and can be lowered by the caller.
